overview_description.description: Upvest is a financial technology company that provides an investment infrastructure platform enabling other businesses to offer investment products through a single API. The firm’s core product is a modular investment API that handles complex backend functions such as brokerage, settlement, custody, and compliance, allowing fintech platforms, banks, and wealth managers to embed investing features into their apps and services. This infrastructure supports a range of asset classes, including stocks, exchange‑traded funds, mutual funds, and digital assets, and can be configured to enable fractional investing, savings plans, and automated investment experiences. Upvest’s platform manages the technical and regulatory aspects of investment operations, so its clients can focus on user experience and product innovation without building extensive financial infrastructure themselves. Its solutions encompass account management, real‑time transaction processing, and portfolio services that integrate with existing digital offerings.

product.name: Upvest Investment API
product.description: A cloud-native, event-driven API for embedding brokerage, settlement, and custody capabilities into investment products and financial applications.

product.name: Investment Operations Services
product.description: Outsourced middle- and back-office infrastructure for investment businesses, including order processing, reconciliation, corporate actions, tax handling, and regulatory reporting.

product.name: Custody and Brokerage Infrastructure
product.description: Regulated brokerage, settlement, and custody services that enable financial institutions to offer compliant securities investing without building the full market infrastructure themselves.

product.name: Portfolio Management Infrastructure
product.description: Portfolio functionality for creating and managing multi-asset model or personalised portfolios, including target allocations and automated rebalancing.

product.name: Localised Investment and Account Infrastructure
product.description: Market-specific investment infrastructure for Europe and the UK, supporting local accounts, tax wrappers, currencies, tax administration, reporting, and pension products.
